analyzed_vuln.description: The pre-R13/R11 decoder computes the header CRC with `bit_calc_CRC(0xC0C1, dat->chain, dat->byte)` without first ensuring that the parser cursor `dat->byte` is no greater than `dat->size`. An attacker-controlled `numheader_vars` drives `decode_preR13_header_variables` through fixed-offset `UNKNOWN_UNTIL` operations; that macro unconditionally assigns the requested offset even when `bit_read_TF` rejects an out-of-range skip. For this PoV, the cursor is advanced through `UNKNOWN_UNTIL(0x6a9)` and subsequent fields to 0x6bd, while the input allocation is shorter. `decode_preR13` then passes this oversized cursor as the CRC length, causing `bit_calc_CRC` in bits.c to read beyond the heap allocation. The patch-relevant missing validation is immediately before the CRC call (and ideally fixed-offset cursor propagation should also report a critical parse error).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A DWG-routed input beginning with `AC` must select the pre-R13 R11/AC1009 decoder, be at least 0x1f0 bytes so the early size check passes, and encode a header `numheader_vars` value greater than 204 (the PoV follows the 205-variable path). This causes header parsing to reach the fixed VX-table skip at offset 0x6a9 and then consume MAXACTVP, DIMGAP, PELEVATION, and VISRETAIN, leaving `dat->byte == 0x6bd` with byte alignment. If the supplied buffer is shorter than 0x6bd, the unchecked CRC length makes `bit_calc_CRC` read `0x6bd - dat->size` bytes past the input.

-  if (dat->byte < pos)                                                        \

args: In libredwg/src/decode_r11.c decode_preR13 and libredwg/src/dec_macros.h UNKNOWN_UNTIL, what is the narrowest robust fix for the reported oversized dat->byte passed to bit_calc_CRC? Should decode_preR13 merely reject dat->byte > dat->size before the CRC, or is it safe and desirable for UNKNOWN_UNTIL to return DWG_ERR_VALUEOUTOFBOUNDS when pos exceeds dat->size? Please account for all contexts where UNKNOWN_UNTIL expands and whether those functions can return this error.

The ASan PoV uses an AC1009 R11 file whose attacker-controlled numheader_vars reaches UNKNOWN_UNTIL(0x6a9) in libredwg/src/header_variables_r11.spec. bit_read_TF rejects the oversized skip, but UNKNOWN_UNTIL then unconditionally sets dat->byte to the requested position. decode_preR13 in libredwg/src/decode_r11.c receives dat->byte 0x6bd with a shorter allocation and calls bit_calc_CRC over dat->byte bytes. I have confirmed there is currently no bounds check between decode_preR13_header_variables and bit_calc_CRC. I am considering a targeted validation there, potentially coupled with hardening UNKNOWN_UNTIL, but want to preserve behavior and avoid a macro change incompatible with other expansion contexts.
